QD-RP1-100 Release Sequence
QD-RP1-100 · Rev B · RP-1 fill line · Busari Lab, Morgan State

How the QD actuator releases the RP-1 fill line

A ring-shaped piston wraps the Parker socket. Air under the piston pulls the coupler sleeve back, the locking balls drop out of the plug groove, and line pressure pushes the ground half away. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, or step through the sequence.

    Actuator parts (housing, piston, key ring, stop spacer, clamp plate) and the Smalley C175-L10 wave spring are the Rev B CAD. The Parker socket and plug are approximated from Assem1.SLDPRT, and their balls and sleeve relief are drawn schematically to show the locking action. Forces assume 80 psi on a 1069 mm² annulus.
